brief: A catalogue for discovering open-source software, comparing alternatives, and finding useful developer tools. The identity should be abstract, confident, understated, technical, and clear at small sizes.
criteria: An independent silhouette, an open stepped channel, pure black and white, and the existing lowercase Inter wordmark.

concepts.name: Offset Blocks
concepts.idea: Two solid, opposed blocks are separated by a stepped diagonal channel.
rationale: The two registration notches define the silhouette independently from the name.
A 16-unit construction grid keeps the terminal gaps open at 16 px.
The lowercase Inter Medium wordmark is retained and fully outlined.

recommendation: Approved for Altstack. Use the horizontal lockup as the primary signature and the symbol independently in compact placements.
next_steps: Use the supplied vector masters and fixed lockups.
Use the pixel-aligned small master for 16-32 px placements.
Follow the included one-page usage guide.
